text:
Alex Chen: pushed fixes to PR #3422 — addressed the requested changes: removed the redundant null-check in router, simplified the retry backoff logic, and added a unit test for the flaky path. PTAL when you have a minute, trying to merge before tomorrow's canary window.
Priya Nair: thanks — quick q: did you run a perf pass on staging after the backoff change? worried about tail latency.
Alex Chen: ran a quick perf job against staging. small median bump but p95 unchanged. bench output pasted below:
```
bench (staging) before -> after
median: 12ms -> 13ms
p95: 38ms -> 38ms
requests: 10k
```
Marco Ruiz: nice, looks fine. left one inline nit about the variable name in router.go (routerDelay -> retryDelay) — otherwise LGTM.
Alex Chen: good catch — renamed and pushed a squashed commit (force-pushed to the PR branch).
Jordan Lee: can you also sanity-check the token handling change? I added a quick security pass earlier but want an explicit thumbs-up.
Alex Chen: yep, I double-checked the token lifecycle; we only handle copies now, nothing stored longer than req lifetime. I added a comment and removed an accidental log.
Jordan Lee: OK from security perspective. small suggestion to zero the buffer after use (left comment).
Alex Chen: implemented zeroing and pushed.
Priya Nair: approved. :thumbsup:
Marco Ruiz: approved.
Jordan Lee: approved.
Alex Chen: planning to merge after 14:00 UTC to hit the canary slot. pinging if anyone expects conflicts or wants to hold.
Priya Nair: no conflict from me, go ahead.
Marco Ruiz: nope, merge when ready.
Jordan Lee: no objections.
Alex Chen: thanks all — merging at ~14:05 UTC, will watch canary and revert if anything odd. (will post follow-up if we see regressions)
